infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nino uses your photo library to choose profile pictures and local-only posts.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nino uses your camera to capture photos and videos for local-only posts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nino uses your microphone to record audio with local-only videos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Nino to select photos and videos for local-only posts and profile pictures.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Nino to capture photos and videos for local-only posts.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Nino to record audio for local-only videos.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Nino to use your camera to capture photos and videos for local-only posts.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Nino to record audio with local-only videos.
